original_source_text: Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Arrays (CGRAs) are promising as accelerators for energy and performance benefits. Agile and accu- rate energy estimates are essential to explore the CGRA design space and guide algorithm mapping decisions. Existing estimations are agile but inaccurate since they do not factor in the impact of wires in the design. This paper presents synchoros energy es- timation methodology for post-route accurate estimations. The methodology leverages the properties of synchoros VLSI design style to incorporate the impact of interconnects in the design. Over- all, our methodology achieves 98% estimation accuracy relative to post-route results for algorithms irrespective of variations in functionality, dimensions, and parallelism.
